description: Evidence, Assumption, Risk, Exception and Change Request with typed decision relationships; no authority activation.
statements: CREATE TABLE governance.assumption_status(code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO governance.assumption_status VALUES ('UNTESTED'),('SUPPORTED'),('WEAKENING'),('INVALIDATED'),('REPLACED')
CREATE TABLE governance.verification_state(code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO governance.verification_state VALUES ('UNVERIFIED'),('VERIFIED'),('DISPUTED')
CREATE TABLE governance.change_request_status(code text PRIMARY KEY)
INSERT INTO governance.change_request_status VALUES ('DRAFT'),('ANALYSIS'),('TESTING'),('REVIEW'),('APPROVAL'),('APPROVED'),('DEPLOYED'),('VERIFIED'),('REJECTED'),('ROLLED_BACK')

CREATE TABLE governance.evidence (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), source_type text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(source_type)<>''), source_ref text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(source_ref)<>''), authority_level text, document_reference text, captured_at timestamptz NOT NULL, freshness_at timestamptz, summary text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(summary)<>''), confidence numeric CHECK(confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1), verification_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNVERIFIED' REFERENCES governance.verification_state(code))
CREATE TRIGGER governance_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON governance.evidence FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.evidence FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON governance.evidence FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.evidence FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()

CREATE TABLE governance.assumption (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), statement text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(statement)<>''), confidence numeric CHECK(confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1), validation_method text, trigger text, impact_if_false text, last_review timestamptz, next_review timestamptz, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNTESTED' REFERENCES governance.assumption_status(code), CHECK(last_review IS NULL OR next_review IS NULL OR next_review>=last_review))
CREATE TRIGGER governance_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON governance.assumption FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.assumption FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON governance.assumption FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.assumption FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()

CREATE TABLE governance.risk (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), category text, description text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(description)<>''), cause text, event text, consequence text, probability numeric CHECK(probability BETWEEN 0 AND 1), impact text, velocity text, inherent_risk numeric CHECK(inherent_risk>=0), control_effectiveness numeric CHECK(control_effectiveness BETWEEN 0 AND 1), residual_risk numeric CHECK(residual_risk>=0), treatment text, trigger text, escalation_threshold text, review_date timestamptz, confidence numeric CHECK(confidence BETWEEN 0 AND 1), status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES governance.record_status(code))
CREATE TRIGGER governance_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON governance.risk FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.risk FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON governance.risk FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.risk FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()

CREATE TABLE governance.exception (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), trigger text, description text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(description)<>''), severity text, impact text, containment text, required_decision_id uuid, recovery_path text, sla interval CHECK(sla>=interval '0 seconds'), expires_at timestamptz, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES governance.record_status(code), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,required_decision_id) REFERENCES governance.decision(business_id,id))
CREATE TRIGGER governance_initialize BEFORE INSERT ON governance.exception FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_initialize()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_before_write BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON governance.exception FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_before_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_after_write AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON governance.exception FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.organization_after_write()
CREATE TRIGGER governance_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON governance.exception FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION audit.reject_organization_truncate()

CREATE TABLE governance.change_request (id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reference)<>''), business_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES core.business(id), owner_actor_id uuid NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(version>0), created_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, updated_by text NOT NULL DEFAULT current_user, UNIQUE(business_id,reference), UNIQUE(business_id,id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,owner_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), requested_change text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(requested_change)<>''), target_reference text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(target_reference)<>''), reason text NOT NULL CHECK(btrim(reason)<>''), impact text, compatibility text, reviewer_actor_id uuid, approval_id uuid, deployment_reference text, verification_reference text, status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' REFERENCES governance.change_request_status(code), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,reviewer_actor_id) REFERENCES core.actor_business(business_id,actor_id), FOREIGN KEY(business_id,approval_id) REFERENCES governance.approval(business_id,id))
